rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial term for a young person, including a young man.

example.english: That youth always helps the old lady carry groceries.
example.traditional: 嗰個後生仔成日幫阿婆拎餸。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 hau6 saang1 zai2 seng4 jat6 bong1 aa3 po4 ling1 sung3

rows.note: Use this for the abstract quality of youth or the early period of life, rather than for a young person.

example.english: Youth only comes once, so don't give up so quickly.
example.traditional: 青春得一次，唔好咁快放棄。
example.jyutping: cing1 ceon1 dak1 jat1 ci3 m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 fong3 hei3

rows.note: Choose this written or formal term when referring to a young man as a member of an age group, rather than using the colloquial 後生仔.

example.english: Every youth should actively participate in social affairs.
example.traditional: 每個青年都應該積極參與社會事務。
example.jyutping: mui5 go3 cing1 nin4 dou1 jing1 goi1 zik1 gik6 caam1 jyu5 se5 wui6 si6 mou6
